sources.title: (PDF) GR00T N1: An Open Foundation Model for Generalist Humanoid Robots
sources.snippet: GR00T N1 is a Vision-Language-Action (VLA) model with a dual-system architecture. The vision-language module (System 2) interprets the environment through vision and language instructions.

sources.title: NVIDIA Isaac GR00T N1: An Open Foundation Model for Humanoid Robots | Research
sources.snippet: A robust Vision-Language-Action (VLA) model is crucial for such advanced capabilities. To this end, we developed GR00T N1, a generalist robot model trained on a diverse dataset that includes egocentric human videos, real and simulated robot trajectories, and synthetic data.
